summary: Approach to the Walter Taylor Bridge, no stopping, no parking and no verge.
reasons: Through road onto bridge, no parked cars
Barrier edge, nowhere to pull off

drivers.seclusion: Homes are 35 m or more away, but the kerb is in full view of traffic beside a bridge.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb runs along a crash barrier above the rail cutting with no verge or pull-in.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-lane approach with queued vehicles and rail noise.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time signs; no cars parked along it.

sun_shade: Mostly open to sun; a few trees on the east side.
